in_marathi.name: Malay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain or Hill
in_marathi.long_meaning: Malay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Malini' which means mountain or hill. This name is associated with strength and resilience, just like the mountains that have withstood the test of time.
